text:
Liam: Heads up — noticed a spike in spot interruption rate for our mixed-pool in us-west1. Dashboard shows ~7% interruption rate in the last 10m for a100-pool-3. Anyone else seeing this? @Natalie
Natalie: Oncall here, getting pages. SLO for inference tail latency might be impacted if this continues. Are we auto-draining nodes on these interrupts?
Infra Bot: ALERT: spot_pool_interruptions rate > 0.05 for 10m (region=us-west1, pool=a100-mixed). Incident ID: INC-20250312-42. https://grafana.redwood/alerts/INC-20250312-42
Erin: Checking metrics now. Query I'm looking at:
```
sum(rate(node_spot_interruptions_total{pool="a100-mixed",region="us-west1"}[5m])) by (zone)
/ sum(node_gpu_capacity{pool="a100-mixed",region="us-west1"}) by (zone)
```
Shows spike concentrated in us-west1-b (other zones stable).
Sam: If it's a single zone flare, we can shift scheduling off that zone and scale on-demand temporarily. Suggest: scale on-demand +30 GPUs and set drain on the affected spot nodes. Small cost hit but avoids SLO breaches.
Natalie: Can we temporarily change the autoscaler policy to prefer on-demand when interruption_rate > 0.03? Do we have a short runbook for this path?
Erin: Runbook snippet:
```
- set pool.eviction_policy=drain (affected zone)
- increase on_demand_priority for critical-queue
- disable spot_batching for critical routes
- create canary routing rule for 5m
```
I can push the changes if folks agree.
Maria: FYI cost team: switching to on-demand will be ~3.2x spot rate. For ~100 GPUs sustained over 20m that's a non-trivial delta; estimate ~$X. We have runway but flagging for visibility.
Liam: Quick mitigation: Erin, please apply drain + bump on-demand for 15m. I'll silence noisy pages and adjust alert thresholds so we don't page on transient blips.
Erin: Applied: pool.eviction_policy=drain for us-west1-b, scaled on-demand +30 instances, disabled spot_batching on critical-service routes. Watching cpu/gpu queues and schedule desync.
Infra Bot: UPDATE: alert resolved — spot_pool_interruptions rate back below 0.03 for 10m. Incident INC-20250312-42 auto-closed. Metrics timeline: interruption_rate 0.07 -> 0.02 -> 0.015.
Natalie: Thanks. I'll open a short postmortem if this recurs. Proposal: add dashboard panel for "anticipated eviction window" (5/15/60m) and an SLO-impact calc (requests at risk vs normal). Also consider an automatic short-term on-demand fallback policy when region interruption_rate > threshold.
Sam: Agree on fallback policy. Also worth adding a metric for "recent evictions per pod" so we can correlate with model cache churn.
Liam: Good notes — Erin can you add a quick grafana panel and a prometheus alert tweak PR? We should avoid paging on single-zone short spikes but keep SLO-driven escalations.
Erin: Will PR alert tweak (lower severity for transient spikes, add severity=page only if SLO error budget burn > 0.5%) and add the panel. Posting links when ready.
